caption: The drawing depicts a large bell, labeled as "Plantation Slave Bell" on the left side of the image in printed text. The bell is metallic in appearance, with detailed linear engravings and ornamental bands encircling its surface. The bell is mounted on a thick, horizontally placed wooden beam with visible grain patterns, which is secured by two diagonal iron straps bolted into the beam. At the top, there is a central, vertically oriented iron bolt or hook for suspension. The bell also features a series of inscribed texts and two labeled rectangular panels on its body, one of which reads "APPARTIENT A MONSIEUR BERNARD ARGAIN." Decorative patterns border both the upper and lower sections of the bell. The composition includes precise measurements: the width of the bell at its base is 20 inches, its height is 26 inches, and the length of the wooden beam is 30 inches; additionally, the central width of the beam at the top is marked as 10 inches. The image is rendered in black line art on a yellowed, aged paper background, creating a monochrome effect with fine shading to indicate form and texture.
title: Fontainbleau Plantation Bell
